events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: A Gift
events.text: Unexpectedly, [character] has arrived with a thoughtful gift! You have no idea how he knew, but he got you exactly what you most wanted, a set of carved miniature soldiers with which to fight mock battles!

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: A Remarkable Youth

options.text: Send him away, I must remain loyal.

events.text: One evening, your eyes fall upon the young [character]. He fascinates you with his charm, moving you in a way you have never felt before. Loyalty to your spouse stays your hand, but the heart cannot help but yearn for this beguiling man.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: A Royal Affair
events.text: [character] has been making no secret of his attraction to you, sneaking you flirtatious looks and smiles whenever you are together. When [character] announces that he is taking a long trip to the country, it seems like the perfect opportunity to act. [character] approaches you the morning after his departure and boldly states his desire to be with you. Will you take [character] as a lover, or stay loyal to [character]?

events.name: A Royal Affair

[character] approaches you the morning after his departure and boldly states his desire to be with you. Will you take [character] as a lover, or stay loyal to [character]?

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Another Bullseye
events.text: As you practice your archery one day you notice that you have an audience. It’s [character], and it occurs to you that this is not the first time you have noticed him watching you shoot. Seeing your regard, he approaches. “I’ve never seen anyone shoot as well as you, [character], perhaps you could teach me?” he asks, staring into your eyes. You begin calculating what weight of pull he could handle before realizing that archery training is not his sole motivation.

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Bawdy Poem
events.text: A grinning [character] approaches you, “[character]! Listen to this...” he proceeds to recite a raunchy and extremely detailed poem depicting how the two of you could make love. It contains several rude puns, an inspired simile, and very creative use of olive oil.

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Bold Boasts

options.text: I do have a few exploits in mind!
I prefer to talk to my friends.

events.text: At a social gathering you have just finished regaling your friends with a tale of derring-do when [character] approaches you. “[character], you are the boldest man I have ever met!” he exclaims, “Perhaps we could dine together and you could tell me more of your heroic deeds?”

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Brave Boasts

options.text: I do have a few exploits in mind!
I prefer to talk to my friends.

events.text: At a social gathering you have just finished regaling your friends with a tale of derring-do when [character] approaches you. “[character], you are the bravest man I have ever met!” he exclaims, “Perhaps we could dine together and you could tell me more of your heroic deeds?”

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Declaration of Love

options.text: Profess your feelings and ask to be wed.
Carefully explain that you want things to remain as they are.
Step back, this is a mistake.

events.text: Your lover, [character], waits for you by the balcony. You can tell that something is troubling him, recognizing the way he plays with the sleeve of his robes and the tightness around his lips. Quietly and intimately, [character] confesses to loving you. He doesn't expect anything to change, but hopes, dreams, that you may feel the same and take him as your husband.

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Dreamy Gaze

options.text: I am more than just a pretty face!

events.text: While spending some quality time with [character] you suddenly realize that he is staring at you with a dreamy expression. “[character],” he eventually says, “I’m entranced by your beauty. I love you! Say that you feel the same way!”

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Enamored

options.text: This match is a boon to both groups!
I have no time for flights of fancy.
I will woo him, in order to secure favorable trade deals.

events.text: Recent court gossip centers on the chief of the [tribe], [character], and his growing fondness for you. He saw you during a recent diplomatic visit, and the tribal ruler was visibly smitten. How can we use this relationship to our advantage?

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Entirely Absorbed

options.text: How kind! Perhaps you could join me in eating this?

events.text: As you sit in the library, pondering the meaning of ancient scrolls, you become aware of two things. First, that there’s a delicious smell in the air, and second, that you’ve been sitting here for hours and are ravenous. You look around for the source of the smell and spot [character] arriving with some hot food. “You get so lost in your scrolls, [character], you must remember to take care of yourself too!” he says, offering you the food.

events.name: Entirely Absorbed

options.text: How kind! Perhaps you could join me in eating this?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Exotic Getaway

options.text: We will make the most of our time here in [city].
There is no time for frivolity.

events.text: Your husband, [character], wishes to embark on an enchanting expedition to foreign shores, where the two of you may spend your days enjoying wine and song among striking vistas. It sounds like a wonderful escape, but is this the best time for an exotic getaway?

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Extravagant Gift

options.text: An amazing gift, please tell me how you won it!

events.text: Suddenly [character] comes running up excitedly. “[character]!” he calls, “Look what I have for you! I won it in a bet and it seemed like it would suit you.” He thrusts something into your hands… it’s a gold neck chain that looks rather valuable.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Family Debts

options.text: Threaten the debt collector with death.
Bring the debt collector onto the court.

events.text: Your lover, [character], comes to you with a personal request. His extended family in [city] is being harassed by a debt collector, and they are in danger of losing their home and property. This is becoming quite a messy situation, but several solutions come to mind.

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Hook, Line, and Sinker
events.text: Something is different about your latest fishing trip with [character]. While he is catching fish as well as he always does, he seems distracted. Eventually, as you clean today’s catch, he gathers the courage to say, “[character], I must confess that I am unsatisfied by what I have landed so far. I think you would be the greatest catch of all!” You flounder for a moment before replying:

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Hook, Line, and Sinker
events.text: Something is different about your latest fishing trip with [character]. While he is catching fish as well as he always does, he seems distracted. Eventually, as you clean today’s catch, he gathers the courage to say, “[character], I must confess that I am unsatisfied by what I have landed so far. But it doesn't matter, I think you are the greatest catch of all!” You flounder for a moment before replying:

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Horsing Around

options.text: This is so spur of the moment, but yes!

events.text: As has been your custom for the past several weeks, you meet [character] at the pasture for your daily ride together. Something is different about him today though, he seems nervous. “Hello [character],” he says, “I’ve been wondering, are you ready for a stable relationship?”

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Joint Venture
events.text: As [character] and you go over the accounts of your latest merchant caravan, you realize that your partnership with him is now more profitable than your next two ventures combined! [character] seems equally pleased, if not more so, as he makes a final note and puts down his quill. “Excellent news again, [character]!” he exclaims, “Perhaps to celebrate we could have a meal together and see where the night takes us?”

events.name: Joint Venture

[character] seems equally pleased, if not more so, as he makes a final note and puts down his quill. “Excellent news again, [character]!” he exclaims, “Perhaps to celebrate we could have a meal together and see where the night takes us?”

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Kiss, Marry, Kill

options.text: Refuse to partake in their plot.

events.text: Returning to your chambers, you are shocked to find [character] sitting in calm conversation with your husband, [character]. You stand frozen in the doorway, uncertain of how to proceed. "Ah, [character]! We were waiting for you." [character] beckons you over. "We have been discussing and think it best that [character] should also be taken as a husband. However, we have a condition." [character] continues the thought, "We want [character] dead. You can have us both, but we will not tolerate any other rivals."

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Love Affair

options.text: Lovers are a privilege and a tradition.
I cannot have my reputation tarnished.
I will wed [character] as well. Throw us a lavish wedding!

events.text: Everyone in court is gossiping about your scandalous love affair with [character]. People talk of nothing else. Perhaps it is time we address the matter openly.

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Love Letter
events.text: You awaken to find that a letter has been left by the door to your chambers. It is a love-letter from [character]. In it he expresses the depth of his feelings for you, and asks if you feel the same way.

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Love Poem

options.text: That was beautiful, just like you!
Thank you for the poem, but I don’t feel the same way.

events.text: A blushing [character] approaches you with a shy smile and says, “[character], I’ve wanted to tell you this for some time now. I love you, and I’ve written this poem especially for you…” His poem hardly rhymes at all, but it is a heartfelt confession of love.

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Love Rival

options.text: You know I’m in love with [character].

events.text: At a friendly gathering with [character] you find yourself alone for a few moments when [character] approaches you. “[character], we really should spend more time together,” he says, with a mischievous smile.

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Love Rival

options.text: Show me what a man you are!

events.text: At a friendly gathering with [character] you find yourself alone for a few moments when [character] approaches you. “[character] is no good for you! You should be with a real man!” he exclaims passionately.

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Love(?) is in the air
events.text: Seeming almost angry at you, [character] demands to speak with you in private. Once he is alone with you he seems even more annoyed. Gathering himself, he speaks stiffly to you, “I never thought I would fall for a <p.is_sub.S0=SUBJECT_ZEALOT>pious fool<p=SUBJECT_SCHOLAR>bookish intellectual<p=SUBJECT_ORATOR>rambling windbag<p=SUBJECT_DIPLOMAT>worm-tongued manipulator<p=SUBJECT_SCHEMER>scheming sneak<p=SUBJECT_HERO>puffed up braggart<p=SUBJECT_TACTICIAN>conceited bore<p=SUBJECT_COMMANDER>military-obsessed fanatic<p=SUBJECT_BUILDER>tinkering obsessive<p=SUBJECT_JUDGE>judgemental type<else>bore with no personality<end> like you, but for some reason I have! Now you know, you <p.is_sub.S1=SUBJECT_ZEALOT>preachy<p=SUBJECT_SCHOLAR>bookish<p=SUBJECT_ORATOR>rambling<p=SUBJECT_DIPLOMAT>wordy<p=SUBJECT_SCHEMER>sneaky<p=SUBJECT_HERO>boastful<p=SUBJECT_TACTICIAN>strategic<p=SUBJECT_COMMANDER>strategic<p=SUBJECT_BUILDER>fiddly<p=SUBJECT_JUDGE>judgemental<else>boring<end> fool.” Having said his piece, [character] storms off.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Lover Confronted

options.text: Demand that they both leave your sight.

events.text: You hear the screaming long before you reach the fight. In the midst of the chaos, your lover [character] and spouse [character] are facing off, insults and vases hurtling between the two men. A servent explains that [character] has been making jibes and innuendos to [character], who, having tried to rise above reacting to your relationship on the side, finally snapped. The pair grow silent when they see you, a flush of shame, anger, and frustration creeping up their cheeks. There is no continuing as before after this public display. What will you decide?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Marriage Unbound

options.text: Even without love, [character] is my partner.

events.text: [character] has made no secret of his affections for you, leading to whispers around the palace as to where your heart truly lies. Worried about the rumors getting out of hand, you go to confront [character] in his livings. Desperately, he pleads with you, "How long must we wait to be together my love? I can't take it any more, he doesn't love you like I do! Please, denounce [character] and we can finally be wed."

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Missed Signs

options.text: But I’ve been trying to tell you the same for months too!
I had no idea. Let’s keep it that way.

events.text: Your good friend [character] seems upset today. After some questioning, he eventually looks at you in puzzlement and asks, “Are you really so blind? I’ve been trying to make it clear for months now. I’m in love with you, you fool!” This is a surprising revelation, but suddenly a lot of previously strange actions make a lot more sense. The confusing talk about birds. The marriage proposal. That incident where he punched a royal guard ‘for standing too close to you’. They were all attempts to show his feelings!

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Missed Signs

options.text: But I’ve been trying to tell you the same for months too!
I had no idea. Let’s keep it that way.

events.text: Your husband, [character] seems upset today. After some questioning, he eventually looks at you in puzzlement and asks, “Are you really so blind? I’ve been trying to make it clear for months now. I’m in love with you, you fool!” This is a surprising revelation, but suddenly a lot of previously strange actions make a lot more sense. The confusing talk about birds. The musings about how political marriages sometimes work out very well. That incident where he punched a royal guard ‘for standing too close to you’. They were all attempts to show his feelings!

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Mocking Laughter

options.text: I’m always interested in a man with a skilful tongue!
Perhaps, if I ever meet one.

events.text: “- and then I told him, his face makes me think him both a thief and a murderer, for surely he has killed a horse and stolen its ass!” You conclude your tale of verbally destroying a rival to the glee of your surrounding friends. [character] seems to be especially delighted, and he steps close to you, eyes maliciously amused. “Your tongue is sharper than any blade, [character], but does your heart have room for a man of equal wit?”

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Night Terrors

options.text: Uh, yes. I could do that!

events.text: One dark and stormy night as you sit alone and unsettled, you hear a rapping at your chamber door. You investigate to find [character] there with a pair of warm drinks. “These storms always scare me so, [character], perhaps you could keep me safe tonight?”

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Night Terrors

options.text: Uh, yes. I could do that!

events.text: One dark and stormy night as you sit alone and unsettled, you hear a rapping at your chamber door. You investigate to find [character] there with a pair of warm drinks. “These storms always scare me so, [character], perhaps you could keep me safe tonight?”

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Party Time

options.text: Guards, kill this man for assault!
Sadly, I already have commitments and must decline your offer.

events.text: [character] stops before you within the hallways of the palace and asks to speak with you privately. "I am hosting a small party with a few notables of the court this evening." He smiles with a libertine flourish and leans in close, smelling of incense and citrus. "I'm sure you are intimately familiar with many of the more promiscuous among them." He steals a kiss from you and steps away, bowing to take his leave.

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Pillow Talk
events.text: As [character] unties you after another long and passionate evening together, he pauses to say, “As much as I enjoy working through the Kama Sutra with you, I need something more. Do you love me?”

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Pillow Talk
events.text: As [character] unties you after another long and passionate evening together, he pauses to say, “As much as I enjoy working through the Kama Sutra with you, I want our marriage to be something more. Do you love me?”

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Plane Speaking
events.text: While you have little time for Carpentry these days, you try to make time to work through a little project with [character] whenever you can. His skill is easily a match for your own, and he is a joy to work with. “Great news, [character],” he says, arriving in your workroom, “I’ve arranged a delivery of oak for that bed you’ve been wanting to make. And I’ve been thinking, once we’ve made it we should put it to good use!”

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Proposition

options.text: Yes, I would like to know you very well!
I think I know enough about you already.

events.text: During a chance encounter, [character] steps close to you and, in a suggestive tone, hints that he would like to spend some time getting to know you better. While at first you are taken aback by this direct proposition, you have to admit it has a certain tactless charm.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Renowned Beauty

options.text: I must have been under a spell...
I need better counsel. Make my heir Chancellor.

events.text: While visiting a noble house, you encounter a beautiful lady and become infatuated with her beauty. Your Chancellor has expressed concern. You are married, and it would be unwise to divorce your wife. What will you do?

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Ribald Letter

options.text: Write back offering some more ideas for joint activities.

events.text: You have received a letter from [character]. It reveals that he is in love with you. In it he asks if you feel the same way, and makes several explicitly erotic suggestions as to how you could spend the next several days.

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Romantic Encounter
events.text: Having received a message asking you to meet [character] in his chambers, you arrive to find the room lit with romantic lanterns and flower petals scattered on every surface. [character] greets you with two cups of wine and offers you one. “So glad you could make it, [character],” he says with a smile, “won’t you join me for a drink?”

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Sheer Strength

options.text: I need to do another set.

events.text: Sweaty from finishing your daily workout of 100 push ups, 100 sit ups, 100 squats, and a 4.5 league run, you are looking forward to a bath and a massage when you notice [character] watching you admiringly. “You’re so strong, [character]!” he blurts suddenly, “you could pick me up so easily!”

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Spartan Style
events.text: [character] and you are sharing your daily meal of gruel, both sitting arrow-straight on your stools, when he suddenly produces a small pot. “Don’t you ever get tired of plain gruel, [character]?” he asks. “Would you like a little honey to sweeten it?” You stare at him, aghast, for a moment before he cracks a small smile and reveals the pot to be empty. “Merely a jest, [character]. I had to be sure of your resolve before asking. Shall we become lovers?”

events.name: Spartan Style
events.text: [character] and you are sharing your daily meal of gruel, both sitting arrow-straight on your stools, when he suddenly produces a small pot. “Don’t you ever get tired of plain gruel, [character]?” he asks. “Would you like a little honey to sweeten it?” You stare at him, aghast, for a moment before he cracks a small smile and reveals the pot to be empty. “Merely a jest, [character]. I had to be sure of your resolve before telling you. I have decided that I love you.”

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: The Joy of War

options.text: You shall be the Captain of my heart!
You shall be the Captain of my Vanguard.

events.text: As your debate about the relative merits of cart-borne logistics versus mule-borne draws to a close, you reflect that [character] and you have been spending a lot of time together recently. Sparring matches, war games, long talks about the art of war, and various other joint activities have brought you much closer together. [character] seems to be having similar thoughts as he leans towards you and says, “[character], we make a formidable team! I want to always fight beside you. Together we could conquer the world!”

events.name: The Right Angle

options.text: It’s quite annoying when you interrupt me.

events.text: “- and, of course, the area of the square whose side is the hypotenuse must always be equal to -”, your conclusion is interrupted by [character] as he finishes your thought for you, “the sum of the areas of the squares on the other two sides!” This has been happening more and more often recently. [character] always knows what you are thinking when you discuss the latest theorem together. [character] suddenly places a hand on your cheek and says, “You have a beautiful mind, [character]. That’s why I love you.”

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: The one that got away

options.text: A few things come to mind!

events.text: “- and then the rod snapped clean in half! Biggest damned fish I ever hooked and it got away!” You conclude your latest fishing tale. Several of your peers commiserate with you, but [character] stands out. “Such a shame about your rod” he says, “Is there anything I could do to take your mind off of it?”

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Thrilling Conversation

options.text: Oh no, I’m far too busy for that.

events.text: During a friendly conversation with [character], he seems to be greatly enjoying your company. He leans towards you, places a gentle hand on your arm, and blushingly confesses that he greatly values your wit. “[character],” he says, “I wish I could talk to you like this every day!”

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Unexpected Flirt

options.text: I’m flattered, curious even, but no thanks.
I have wondered what it would be like.

events.text: You are having an interesting conversation with [character] at a feast when, laughing, he steps closer to you, placing his hand lightly on your arm. “Oh, [character], I have such fun talking to you!”, he says, breathlessly. Suddenly, you realise, he is flirting with you.

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Unexpected Flirt
events.text: As you walk alongside [character], chatting fondly, he suddenly stops and turns to face you. “[character], I treasure our friendship, but have you ever thought that perhaps we could be more than friends?”, he asks nervously.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Unfaithful Tidings

options.text: What ridiculous nonsense. I have no lover!
I have lost my way. Please forgive me.
I am the [title]. I can do what I please.

events.text: Rumors of you being seen with your lover, [character], are circulating in the capital. Your husband [character] comes to you with a simple plea - to stop these painful and increasingly public indiscretions.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Very Charming

options.text: She is charming and makes good company.
Perhaps... It is best to send her away.

events.text: After a brief interaction with [character], you can think of nothing else. You begin taking walks together, and you find yourself charmed by his sweet, clever ways. Should we worry about this acquaintance?
